title: 创建独立 FastAPI 后端项目
description: Create a separate backend/ FastAPI project with isolated dependency metadata, application entrypoint, CORS settings, health check, and local environment example. Include uv-managed dependencies and keep frontend/backend separated.
acceptance_criteria: Backend service can start locally and expose a health check; frontend real API mode has a documented backend base URL target.
review_initial_requirements: Confirm backend/ is separate from src/ and has app entrypoint, dependency metadata, CORS, health check, and env example.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm existing frontend mock mode and npm build are not broken by backend scaffold.
notes: specs:backend-api Scenario Frontend build remains valid; validation:uv run python import app health route passed

title: 补齐后端配置项
description: Add backend configuration for database URL, AI provider credentials, request timeouts, frontend CORS origin, and deterministic test mode.
acceptance_criteria: Config defaults to local SQLite and explicit AI provider settings; missing real AI credentials fail in controlled service responses outside test mode.
review_initial_requirements: Review config module and env example for DATABASE_URL, AI provider/model/key, timeout, CORS origin, and test mode.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm config does not require credentials for automated tests or frontend mock builds.
notes: specs:workout-persistence SQLite/Postgres; ai scan unavailable controlled response; validation:settings loaded database/ai/cors/test mode and controlled missing key error

title: 实现 SQL 模型和迁移
description: Implement SQLAlchemy-compatible database models, session management, and migrations for users, equipment, exercises, workout plans, workout-plan exercises, workout sessions, and set records.
acceptance_criteria: Database can be initialized locally with SQLite and models cover all MVP entities; DATABASE_URL can target Postgres-compatible URLs through the same data layer.
review_initial_requirements: Review SQL models, DB session, migration files, and init command.
review_regression_requirements: Run backend tests that create an isolated test database.
notes: specs:Backend supports SQLite and Postgres-compatible configuration; validation:uv run alembic upgrade head passed after clean SQLite DB; metadata tables inspected

title: 补齐后端种子数据
description: Add backend-owned seed data matching the current frontend mock catalog and stable IDs such as user_local_001 and plan_beginner_day_1.
acceptance_criteria: After setup, profile, equipment catalog, exercise catalog, and default beginner workout plan exist with frontend-compatible stable IDs.
review_initial_requirements: Compare seeded IDs and required fields against frontend TypeScript types and mock catalog.
review_regression_requirements: GET /api/user/profile and GET /api/workout/today return seeded data in tests.
notes: specs:Seeded catalog exists after setup; Seeded IDs remain frontend-compatible; validation:seed command inserted 1 user/6 equipment/6 exercises/1 plan/5 plan exercises/session_local_001

title: 实现 SQL 数据访问服务
description: Add repository/service functions that read the default profile, today workout, exercise details, plan exercises, and saved set records through the SQL data layer.
acceptance_criteria: Service layer returns profile, today workout, exercise detail, plan changes, and saved set records from the database rather than static route literals.
review_initial_requirements: Review service functions for query boundaries and persisted reads.
review_regression_requirements: Backend tests verify added exercise and saved records are queryable after commit.
notes: specs:Added exercise appears in later reads; Saved records are queryable for verification; validation:repository read profile/today, add exercise, save/query records through SQL layer

title: 实现 Pydantic 合同模型
description: Implement Pydantic request and response schemas that mirror the existing frontend TypeScript API contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas include UserProfile, Equipment, Exercise, WorkoutPlan, SetRecord, ScanResult, ParsedWorkoutLog, AddExerciseResponse, and SaveWorkoutLogResponse-compatible fields.
review_initial_requirements: Review schema definitions against src/types/*.ts and src/types/api.ts.
review_regression_requirements: Backend schema/API tests validate representative JSON payloads.
refs: backend/; src/types/api.ts; src/types/workout.ts; src/types/equipment.ts; src/types/exercise.ts; src/types/user.ts
notes: specs:Backend exposes frontend API contract; Backend preserves frontend request shapes; validation:pydantic schemas imported and required fields inspected against TS contracts

title: 实现资料、今日训练和动作详情接口
description: Implement read endpoints for GET /api/user/profile, GET /api/workout/today, and GET /api/exercises/:exerciseId, including controlled 404 responses.
acceptance_criteria: Known resources return frontend-compatible JSON; unknown exercise returns 404 with a controlled error body.
review_initial_requirements: Call read endpoints with test client and inspect response shape/status.
notes: specs:User profile is available; Today workout is available; Exercise detail is available; Unknown exercise is rejected; validation:TestClient GET profile/today/exercise 200 and unknown exercise 404 controlled body

title: 实现加入训练和保存记录接口
description: Implement workout mutation endpoints for POST /api/workout/add-exercise and POST /api/workout/log, ensuring changes persist and later reads reflect them.
acceptance_criteria: Add-exercise returns plan_id, exercise_id, position, message and later today workout includes the exercise; save-log returns success, saved, message and stores records by session/exercise.
review_initial_requirements: Run API tests for add exercise, reread plan, save log, and DB verification.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm invalid IDs produce controlled errors and do not corrupt plan state.
notes: specs:Exercise is added to today workout; Set records are saved; validation:TestClient add-exercise persisted and save-log returned saved count; invalid exercise controlled 404

title: 实现真实 AI 器械识别适配器
description: Implement a real AI equipment-recognition adapter that accepts multipart image uploads and JSON image URLs, calls the configured provider, validates output, and normalizes high- and low-confidence scan responses.
acceptance_criteria: Scan accepts FormData and JSON image_url; high confidence returns structured catalog-backed result; confidence below 0.65 returns need_more_photo true without definitive recommendation; malformed/unavailable AI responses are controlled.
review_initial_requirements: Review adapter prompt/output schema and API tests using stubbed provider responses.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm frontend scan result can render both recognized and low-confidence responses.
notes: specs:Backend uses real AI for equipment recognition; Backend normalizes AI scan output; validation:TestClient scan JSON and multipart with stub provider, low confidence path, and missing key controlled response passed

title: 实现真实 AI 一句话记录解析适配器
description: Implement a real AI workout-log parsing adapter that calls the configured provider, normalizes parsed set records, requires user confirmation, and emits beginner-safe safety warnings for pain or injury language.
acceptance_criteria: Parse returns exercise_name, exercise_id, sets, need_confirmation true, xiaotie_feedback; every set matches SetRecord contract; pain/injury language returns non-diagnostic safety_warning.
review_initial_requirements: Review adapter prompt/output schema and API tests for normal, incomplete, unknown exercise, and safety-warning cases.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm save endpoint still requires confirmed records and does not auto-save parsed output.
notes: specs:Backend uses real AI for natural-language workout log parsing; Backend emits safety warnings; validation:TestClient parse with stub returns confirmation sets, safety keyword warning, and missing key controlled empty parse

title: 更新 real API 环境和联调文档
description: Update frontend environment examples and integration documentation for running the React app against the FastAPI backend in real API mode.
acceptance_criteria: Repository documents backend startup, frontend VITE_USE_REAL_API=true configuration, API base URL, DB setup, AI env vars, and manual real-AI verification steps.
review_initial_requirements: Review README/docs/.env examples for accurate front/back commands.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm no local secrets, DB files, node_modules, virtualenvs, or debug artifacts are documented for commit.
notes: specs:Backend supports frontend real API mode; validation:README/backend README/docs/env examples document FastAPI 8000, SQLite/Postgres, OpenAI env, and manual AI steps

title: 完成前端 real API 最小兼容修复
description: Apply any minimal frontend API compatibility fixes needed so VITE_USE_REAL_API=true can complete the welcome, scan, result, tutorial, workout session, and workout log flow without page rewrites.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend still builds and real API mode can use backend responses for welcome/home/scan/result/exercise/workout/log flow.
review_initial_requirements: Inspect realApi.ts/tieziApi.ts changes and run npm build.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm mock mode remains available when VITE_USE_REAL_API=false.
notes: specs:Frontend runs against real API; Frontend build remains valid; validation:npm run build passed; realApi endpoint/payload review matched backend routes; no frontend page rewrite required

title: 补齐后端测试覆盖
description: Add backend unit and API tests covering schema compatibility, seeded data, persistence, AI adapter normalization, low-confidence scan handling, and safety-warning behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Backend test suite passes in isolated test mode without real AI credentials by using explicit stubs, while preserving real-provider code path for runtime configuration.
review_initial_requirements: Run backend test command and inspect tests for required scenarios.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm tests do not depend on local persistent database state.
notes: specs:all backend API/persistence/AI scenarios; validation:uv run pytest 9 passed in isolated SQLite with AI stubs

title: 执行前后端闭环验收
description: Run backend tests, frontend build, OpenSpec validation, and a local front/back integration smoke check; document any real-AI manual verification steps that require credentials.
acceptance_criteria: openspec validate passes; backend tests pass; npm run build passes; local backend/frontend smoke check reaches real API routes; any credential-limited real AI verification is documented with manual steps and risk level.
review_initial_requirements: Review command outputs and final CSV states.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm all completed issue rows have dev/review/git states closed and commits exist.
notes: specs:Frontend runs against real API; verification methods from plan
